steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application name and package identifiers for compilation context.

steps.title: Define Database Schema and Offline Logic
steps.description: Declare database collections, required fields, and offline calculated properties in api_schema.json.

steps.title: Configure App Manifest
steps.description: Define application components, entry activities, and internet access permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Set Up Gradle Build System
steps.description: Configure the SDK version targets, compiler compatibility, and package configuration parameters.

steps.title: Implement Reusable Backend API Client
steps.description: Develop the BackendApi helper class to facilitate cloud data interactions and authentication.

steps.title: Create User Login Screen Layout
steps.description: Design the login layout with credentials entry, action buttons, and a link for password recovery.

steps.title: Implement User Login Logic
steps.description: Implement LoginActivity with session state, error handling, and transition to registration or recovery.

steps.title: Create Registration Screen Layout
steps.description: Design the layout for entering registration details and password verification.

steps.title: Implement Account Creation Logic
steps.description: Implement RegisterActivity with auto-login capabilities after successful user registration.

steps.title: Create Password Recovery Screen Layout
steps.description: Design the layout for requested password recovery OTP requests and secure updates.

steps.title: Implement Password Recovery Code
steps.description: Implement ForgotPasswordActivity handling email OTP verification and credential updates.

steps.title: Create Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Design the MainActivity layout with live calculated value headers, search criteria, and the list adapter.

steps.title: Design Adapter Rows
steps.description: Create the row layout displaying product names, price, quantity, and product value.

steps.title: Implement Live Dashboard Controller
steps.description: Implement MainActivity logic that performs live stock calculations, real-time inventory updates, and multi-user sync.

steps.title: Building Shop Inventory Sync
steps.description: Run compiler checks, resources packing, and complete building debug package.
